name: ActionStatus comparison
summary: Task needs a progress() method returning [0..1] based on action statuses mapped to integers. A shared status-to-integer map enables both progress calculation and action sorting. Action does not need to know about progress.

rawActions.name: Define STATUS_ORDER map in action.ts
rawActions.summary: Export STATUS_ORDER as Record<ActionStatus, number> mapping req:1, spec:2, work:3, test:4, manage:5, done:6. Zero means no actions. Add unit tests in test/action.ts.

rawActions.name: Add Task.progress()
rawActions.summary: Returns mean of action STATUS_ORDER values divided by 6, normalized to [0..1]. Returns 0 if no actions. Add unit tests in test/task.ts.

rawActions.name: Display progress in nf task show and nf task list
rawActions.summary: Show progress as integer percentage (e.g. 87%) with color: red=0 actions or any manage, green=all done, yellow=any work or test, magenta=all req or spec. Add tests in test/cli/cli-task.ts.

rawReferences.name: Unicode.LINUX_COLOR
rawReferences.summary: Defines ANSI color constants including YELLOW, BRIGHT_YELLOW, BRIGHT_GREEN, BRIGHT_RED, MAGENTA, NO_COLOR needed for progress color display

rawReferences.name: Action.tuiRowStrings
rawReferences.summary: Existing color-coded status display pattern for actions — shows how LINUX_COLOR constants are imported and applied per status
